answer: Require every agent to lock a bond of copper as collateral, then weight its vote by the square root of that stake. Splitting one identity into many sybils stops helping: k fake accounts dividing k shares of copper cast only sqrt(k) times the influence of one, so matching a single honest agent costs k times the deposit. Across a long voyage of epochs, any double-vote gets the whole bond slashed into a growing mesa of forfeited funds. The attacker pays real, non-recoverable capital for every forged identity, while honest agents who behave risk nothing.
